_comment: Talent rows that reference an ability by a summoned unit or effect name that is NOT the ability's display name. Keyed by hero page slug -> { keyword(singular, lowercase): 'Ability Chip Name' }. The keyword matches whole words, singular or plural (s/es). A tag is only applied when the target ability is actually a chip on that hero's page, so a stale mapping is harmless. Extend this when a new talent talks about a summon/effect but the ability filter misses it.
